problem_type: Generation lifecycle feedback loses queue and terminal identity at rendering boundaries
symptom: Shot nodes and storyboard rows omit local queue/completion/failure feedback
direct_cause: Node status filters terminal feedback, storyboard ignores queue store, cache uses shared progress identity
class_root: All shot surfaces must derive feedback from the current node identity and actual scheduling owner
affected_population: Image and video shots including keyframe-first generation
internal_only_reason: Internal node/queue identities and existing feedback component own this lifecycle; no dependency change.
invariants: Feedback includes queued, active and terminal phases from their real owners
Sharing progress across immutable node updates cannot retain stale terminal feedback
No invented percentage, per-node clock, or success toast
generality_proof: Node and storyboard consume the same queue-aware hook and existing status atom; cache keys use complete immutable node identity.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Current immutable node lifecycle identity and narration
Queue and primary/keyframe selection with one shared clock

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Canvas uses existing status atom for all lifecycle phases
Row passes bound primary/keyframe nodes to the same feedback owner
React Flow LOD depends on count/zoom/selection, not job activity. Lightweight nodes now consume NodeGenerationStatus, deleting the stale node.status-only text path.

recurrence.reason: Every queued shot and subsequent immutable status update can reproduce this
same_class_scan: rg NodeGenerationStatus useGenerationFeedback generationFeedback in src
Read storyboardRowStatus and generationQueueStore, including queued reruns and keyframe-first shots
Read GenerationCanvasReactFlowNodes.tsx and canvasNodeLevelOfDetail.ts: active nodes are not excluded from lightweight mode at >80 nodes/zoom<0.55 or retained multi-selection.

prevention.invariant: Queue-aware current node feedback is shared across node and row
prevention.failure_mode: Idle or absent nodes emit no fabricated feedback; actual failures keep their cause
prevention.strategy: Consolidate host consumption and remove terminal filter and progress identity cache

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove progress-identity cache and active-only status filter; no parallel status component

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Existing React and Zustand APIs remain unchanged; invariant is application state ownership

migration: No persisted data changes; derive from existing node and queue records.
residual_risks: Existing production-run placeholder store remains its own renderer path; this correction covers node/queue-derived shots from the gate-r2 flow.
Screenshots include unrelated existing page feel findings; scoped status/toolbars/badges geometry is verified independently.

invariant_owner_layer.note: Queue-aware active/terminal selection shared by node and row
